about: Camrose County is a municipal district in east-central Alberta surrounding the separate City of Camrose—not the city itself. Hamlets such as New Norway, Hay Lakes, Bittern Lake, and Armena sit among parkland farms southeast of Edmonton. About 8,000 people live in Camrose County.
